{{unknown name}} [[File:Thief GDZ47.png|thumb|200px|The thief]] The '''thief''' is a character who appeared [[Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!]]. ==History== The thief appeared in ''[[GDZ47|Run Out the Thieves!]]'', where she is first seen in a picture on a wanted sign that [[Shu]] and {{TP|Shu|Pikachu}} were looking at. Her Pokémon later kidnaps Shu and ties him up while Pikachu gets locked in a cage. Shu sends out his {{p|Wooper}} but the thief's {{p|Sneasel}} and {{p|Houndoom}} get the best of it with {{m|Blizzard}} and {{m|Flamethrower}}, respectively. Their attacks caused Wooper to be bounce over towards Pikachu's cage. Shu provoked the thief causing her to have her Sneasel and Houndoom attack him; however, Shu actually planned for this as his Wooper used {{m|Double Team}} before the thief's Sneasel's and Houndoom's attacks could connect, causing them to strike the cage instead and freeing Pikachu in the process. With Pikachu freed, Pikachu and Wooper incapacitate the thief with a combination of {{m|Thunder}} and {{m|Water Gun}} aimed at the sky. The thief and her Pokémon are defeated, but the thief runs off with an item that she steals from Shu. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Thief |pkmn=Dark-types |width=74 |type1=Dark |img=Thief Pokémon team GDZ.png |epnum=GDZ47 |epname=Run Out the Thieves! |desc=The thief has a team of {{p|Tyranitar}}, {{p|Sneasel}}, {{p|Murkrow}}, {{p|Houndoom}}, {{p|Umbreon}}, and {{p|Houndour}}. Sneasel's only known move is {{m|Blizzard}}.
Houndoom's only known move is {{m|Flamethrower}}.
None of Tyranitar's, Murkrow's, Umbreon's, or Houndour's moves are known.}} {{Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon! characters}} {{-}} {{stub|Manga}} {{DoubleProjectTag|Manga|CharacterDex}} [[Category:Female characters]] [[Category:Dark-type Trainers]] [[Category:Professional thieves]]
